 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Patrick Mahomes looked to Travis Kelce early in Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
 But that first-quarter connection could prove costly for the Kansas City Chiefs.
 Mahomes connected with his tight end on Kansas City's opening drive for a 23-yard gain, but following the tackle from behind Kelce walked gingerly to the sideline, and eventually found his way to the locker room under the supervision of trainers.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Here is the play that saw Kelce reaching for his left ankle following the tackle from Atlanta defender DeMarcco Hellams:
 Kelce limped off the field in obvious pain, and was then spotted having that left ankle retaped by trainers. But the tape job must not have been enough, as Kelce then walked gingerly to the locker room for further evaluation, under the supervision of Kansas City trainers.
